adjudication.rationale: In `app/assets/javascripts/admin/components/embeddable-host.js.es6`, the `delete()` action calls `this.get('host').destroyRecord().then(...)` but does not attach a `.catch(...)`. If the DELETE fails, there is no user feedback (unlike `save()`, which uses `.catch(popupAjaxError)`), and the rejection may go unhandled. The row also won’t be removed because `deleteHost` is only sent on success.
